name: @local/thorn-github-kanban
description: dsh Web UI 插件:GitHub Projects(Projects v2)看板全局面板,读 + 状态写回(拖拽卡片更新 Status)。同一个 npm 包同时提供宿主半边(lib/index.js,@Remote 数据服务)与浏览器半边(lib/client.js,左栏 Global panels 入口 + 主区页面),通过 cordis.patch.yml 挂载。

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:unit && npm run test:react && npm run pack:check
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/pure.test.mjs test/service.test.mjs test/cache.test.mjs test/contract.test.mjs test/syntax.test.mjs
scripts.test:strict: node --unhandled-rejections=strict scripts/smoke-load.mjs && node --unhandled-rejections=strict --test test/pure.test.mjs test/service.test.mjs test/cache.test.mjs test/contract.test.mjs test/syntax.test.mjs test/pack.test.mjs test/react/board-lifecycle.test.mjs test/react/prefs-retry.test.mjs
